items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we went back and Bevul rejoined us.

ctx.x: Then she called them (unintelligible). There have never been so many MF'ers in their lives. And they smiled, you know. But any way, Earl at this time had just won a poll. He wasn't aware of it, he had won a poll in Europe, as a pianist of the year, and we got there and they had everybody to meet us there, and it was just a fabulous -- it was the first time I met Nicole Barkley. You've heard of Nicole. A wonderful person, she really was. You know, she did an awful lot for musicians.
But any way we had quite a successful engagement, but we left Earl. They were just -- Earl was so big, they kept him over there, and we went back and Bevul rejoined us.
Had Earl Garner recorded a lot then?
